title: P24.3M smuggled cigarettes seized in Negros warehouse raid

blocks.text: MURCIA, Negros Occidental — A warehouse in Barangay Santa Rosa yielded more than P24.3 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes after law enforcement operatives raided the facility on Friday morning, Nov. 27. Operatives seized 429 master cases of cigarettes during the operation in Purok Ipil-Ipil, following intelligence reports that illicit tobacco products were being stored in the area, the Police Regional Office Negros Island Region (PRO NIR) reported. No caretaker or owner was present during the inspection of the warehouse and its vicinity. However, police have identified a person of interest for further investigation.
